info.name: Procurement
info.description:
Stage-1 procurement intake — API test cases, grouped by test category.

Folders: **Positive / Negative / Boundary / Business Logic**; inside each, one sub-folder per endpoint.
Every request name starts with its case ID (A-P1, FG-N6, OS-L1 …) so it maps 1:1 to the test-case sheet.

SETUP
1. Set `base_url`.
2. Run **Setup — Tokens → Login (Direct Manager / Managing Director / other role)**; each login stores its own token variable.
3. Open a submission (A-P1) — the test script stores `submission_id` for every later request.
4. File-upload requests ship an empty `file` form field: pick the fixture named in the request description.

Known build note: the byte-identical re-upload shortcut (instant replay / 409 duplicate_content) is disabled in this build, so OS-B1 / OS-B2 re-run full validation instead of short-circuiting.

item.name: Setup — Tokens
item.description: Run these first. Each login stores its bearer token in the matching collection variable, so every test folder below works without pasting tokens by hand. Demo accounts use phone = password.
